versions.changelog:
qiyue-qimen-drawer v1.0.0 — First Release

- New skill to calculate and display Qi Men Dun Jia charts for any specified time.
- Returns core elements: Ju number (阳遁/阴遁), Zhi Fu, Zhi Shi, stems, Kong Wang, Yi Ma.
- Shows detailed chart summary and 9-palace panel based on QiyueAstro’s public API.
- No login or API Key needed; free and stateless usage.
- Clear formatting and strict rules for output; provides action link to QiyueAstro for deeper analysis.
